company.name: Mapbox
company.shortDescription: Mapbox develops a location data platform for mobile and web applications.
company.description: Mapbox is a technology underpinning location-aware businesses and applications that equips organizations with AI-enhanced tools and data to power navigation for people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers and nearly 40 percent of Fortune 500 companies have chosen Mapbox because of the platform's flexibility, security, and privacy compliance.

aiResearchSummary.text: Mapbox is researching viewport systems for dynamically framing a map based on updating data, using telemetry driven states to automatically adjust map parameters and display important features. It develops efficient graphical element top surface rendering in digital maps, dynamic building extrusion in electronic maps, map tile culling for globe representations, stationary classifiers for geographic route trace data, and methods for adjusting route travel time estimates in an electronic map system, covering visualization, data processing, and routing.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $280,000,000, or 45.59% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $575,000, representing 0.09% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $53,082,670 to $1,300,000,000, a 24.49x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 63 (-12 over 90 days) and market heat at 50 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
